t: Beyond Copy-Paste: Why My AI Coding Assistant Needed Python Helpers
s: AI coding assistants excel at generative tasks but struggle with precise deterministic operations like code templating. This article details how Python helper scripts emerged as a more reliable solution for such tasks, enabling a synergy between AI planning and script execution.
sub: AI's generative nature vs. deterministic needs in code modification
Limitations of AI in precise copy/paste and search/replace operations
Python helper scripts as a reliable alternative for deterministic code manipulation
Pipulate framework and its approach to deterministic workflow management
